title: 25 Procreate Brushes for Beginners
author: EasyProcreate
description:
Procreate Sketching Brushes are perfect for beginners and advanced Procreate users. Take full advantage of your tools with our brushes that respond to pressure and incline to create unique, high-quality textures. Create your work as if you were painting on a canvas, because our brushes have the highest resolution and realistic texture. The set also includes blender brushes that you can use to get smooth, yet textured shadows. Bonus – 4 background brushes with paper texture. Just use the background texture (gray) and place it on the top layer to add paper texture to your drawing.
▶︎ How to install:
After purchase, you will be provided with a link to download the file(s). Open the downloaded file on your iPad via Procreate. The downloaded brushset will automatically install and become available for use. If you have any problems with the installation then let me know! 
**The brushes only work on Procreate
Please let me know if you have any questions ♥
